name: Zurich Airport

hours.quote: Die Betriebszeiten des Flughafens Zürich liegen zwischen 06:00 und 23:30 Uhr.

curfew.v: no flights from 23:30 to 06:00 unless an exemption permit is granted; 23:00 to 23:30 is kept only for clearing delays
curfew.quote: Die letzte halbe Stunde (23:00–23:30) ist für den Verspätungsabbau reserviert. ... Während der Sperrzeit benötigen alle Flugzeuge eine Ausnahmebewilligung

runway.v: longest runway, runway 34, is 3,700 m long

slots.v: every IFR movement needs an airport slot before departure or arrival, including positioning, training and maintenance flights; IFR slots come via the dispatcher or handling agent (FBO)
slots.quote: Each IFR aircraft movement is required to previously obtain a mandatory airport slot; this includes positioning, training and flights into/out of maintenance facilities.

handling.v: operators must use one of the handling agents listed in AIP Switzerland for LSZH (unless self-handling is authorised); the airport names BHS Aviation Switzerland AG, Cat Air Service AG, Jet Aviation AG, Motorfluggruppe Zürich, SWISS PRIVILEGE AVIATION SERVICES GmbH and Travelcoup as business-aviation FBOs
handling.quote: Der Handling-Anbieter (FBO) ihrer Wahl kümmert sich um die gesamte Organisation ihres Fluges

deicing.v: de-icing by Swissport at the remote de-icing pads Charlie and Foxtrott (preferred) or on stand; dnata and Jet Aviation de-ice on stand only; Jet Aviation is the contact for business and general aviation
deicing.quote: Deicing operations at remote Deicing pads (RDP) are to be prioritised.

notes: Swiss eAIP (skybriefing) is paid and was not used. ICAO LSZH and IATA ZRH from the FOCA/BAZL airport page. Slot rule: Slot Coordination Switzerland states GA/BA slots cannot be requested from it; IFR slots come via dispatcher or FBO, VFR via the airport's VFR slot tool (Zurich Airport GA page: 'You need a valid airport slot before departure and/or arrival.'). Handling rule quote (slotcoordination.ch): 'Operators are obliged to choose one of the handling agents listed in AIP Switzerland LSZH'. Runway 34 length comes from a diagram label in the airport's 2023 runway-extension fact sheet; extensions of runways 28 and 32 were planned, so re-check after any change. | 2026-10-31 run: de-icing added from 'Winter Operation at Zurich Airport' Issue 1.0 Rev 24 (cover 01.11.2025); a winter 2026/27 revision may appear in November 2026, re-check then. Airport GA page (EN) re-read: 'You need a valid airport slot before departure and/or arrival.'; a flight plan must be filed at least 30 minutes before departure to confirm the slot.
